youtube_title: ₹1 Lakh Gold Jewellery: 10-25% Gone at the Door 💍 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Guess: you buy ₹1 lakh of gold jewellery. How much is gone the moment you leave the shop?

The bill has making charges, usually 10-25%, plus GST. Sell or exchange later and the jeweller pays only for the gold weight: making charges back = ₹0. So gold has to rise a lot just to get you back to zero.

Rule: buy jewellery to wear. To invest in gold, look at regulated options with no making charges, like gold ETFs or gold funds.
Moral: Jewellery is for wearing, not investing.

Source: Angel One; Shriram Finance (2026)
Education only, not investment advice.
